name: Vacuum Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: an orange shop vacuum with a worried face, a black lid and a ribbed hose arching into a floor wand
entry: It sucks up dust, dirt and the odd small Pokémon. What it cannot digest it blows back out as a choking cloud.
how: Use a Vacuum Hose on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Sludge Bomb in this form.
